/ships/cobra-mk3/.title: Cobra Mk III: where every commander starts
/ships/cobra-mk3/.description: A forgiving trader with 20 t of hold and room for four missiles. Every career begins in one, docked at Lave with 100 credits. Fly free in your browser.

/ships/sidewinder/.title: Sidewinder: the pirate’s scout
/ships/sidewinder/.description: Flat, wide and quick to turn, with no hold at all: the first ship of half the pirates on the frontier, and soon at the yards. Fly free in your browser.

/ships/mamba/.title: Mamba: built for racing, flown for raiding
/ships/mamba/.description: Built for racing, flown for raiding: mostly engine, thin shields, four tonnes of hold. Only a Marshal’s Lancer catches her. Fly free in your browser.

/ships/fer-de-lance/.title: Fer-de-lance: a hotel with a fighter’s bones
/ships/fer-de-lance/.description: Nearly two and a half Cobras long, with a glass deck along her spine, built to order. The ship every pilot saves for. Fly free in your browser.

/ships/fer-de-lance/witch-fire/.title: Fer-de-lance Witch-fire Edition
/ships/fer-de-lance/witch-fire/.description: One hundred numbered Fer-de-lances, each glass deck lit in witch-fire. Never sold: each signed over by invitation to people who build Witchspace.

/ships/fer-de-lance/dark/.title: Fer-de-lance Dark Edition
/ships/fer-de-lance/dark/.description: Fifty numbered Fer-de-lances in black-light lines with one white-hot canopy. Never sold: each signed over by invitation to people who build Witchspace.

/ships/viper/.title: Viper: the police ship on your tail
/ships/viper/.description: Fast, cheap, and wherever a station keeps order. If your record isn’t clean, the one on your scanner is already turning. Fly free in your browser.

/ships/lancer/.title: Lancer: the Marshals’ interceptor
/ships/lancer/.description: The fastest ship in the galaxy, flown by the Co-operative Marshals. Kill a commander where there’s law, and one comes for you. Fly free in your browser.

/ships/bastion/.title: Bastion: the Marshals’ carrier
/ships/bastion/.description: An 800 m carrier with eight Lancers aboard. When the Co-operative Marshals arrive in force, this is what drops out of hyperspace. Fly free in your browser.

/ships/falcon/.title: Falcon: the pirate nobody sees twice
/ships/falcon/.description: A lone pirate Legend who runs dark, built by Solo & Sons and never sold. Nobody sees her twice, and nobody forgets. Fly free in your browser.

/ships/titanoboa/.title: Titanoboa: the ship that builds stations
/ships/titanoboa/.description: Wexley-Yorozu’s 2,500 m constructor eats a moon and leaves a station behind, stage by stage over days. Watch one rise. Fly free in your browser.

/ships/bullsnake/.title: Bullsnake: the Titan’s ore hauler and tug
/ships/bullsnake/.description: Short, square and slow, with tractor booms where the guns should be. Bullsnakes feed the Titan moon ore, and they’re her tugs too. Fly free in your browser.

/ships/coriolis/.title: Coriolis Station: matching the spin
/ships/coriolis/.description: A slowly turning station with one docking slot. Match its spin, line up, keep your nerve, or let the docking computer do it. Fly free in your browser.
